director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions ko cricket pitch ki number line par dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Cricket pitch ko 0 se 1 tak ki road samjho. Agar ball pitch ka ek chauthai raasta chale, number line par us jagah ko kaise dhoondogi?
Koi baat nahi, Riya. 0 se 1 ko chaar equal gaps mein baanto; pehla nishaan one-fourth hoga. 2/5 ke liye kitne equal gaps chahiye?
4? Achha, dekhte hain yeh baithta hai ya nahi. Ek udaharan dekho, kadam se kadam. Diya hai: 2/5, 0 aur 1. Pehle: 5 barabar hisse. Ab tak samajh aaya?
Riya, denominator 5 batata hai ki 0 se 1 ke beech 5 equal gaps honge. Ab 2/5 middle se pehle hai ya baad?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: Ab khaali jagah bharo: 2/5 middle ke ___ hai, kyunki 2/5, 1/2 se chhota hai. Riya, tum kya likhogi?

director.text: Riya, khaali jagah mein jagah ka word chahiye, number nahi. 2/5 middle ke kis taraf hai—pehle ya baad?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: Example: 3/8 ko 1/2 se compare karo; 3/8 chhota hai, isliye middle se kis taraf hoga? Ab 2/5 ke liye likho: ___ the middle.

director.text: Riya, ab wahi question: 2/5, 1/2 se chhota hai, toh number line par middle ke pehle hoga ya baad? Tum likho.

director.text: Woh wala: jawab before. 2/5 ke liye “pehle” ya “baad” likhna tha, 8 nahi. Ab nayi practice par chalte hain. Ghar (0) se chai ki dukaan (1) tak ki sadak 2 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Beech wale mark par kaunsa number hai?
